data.one_liner: DataGrid widget for tabular data with editing, sorting, paging and export.
data.what_it_does: It displays data in a grid with support for column types, editing, sorting, filtering, grouping, paging, and export to Excel/PDF. The widget is highly configurable and supports RTL and accessibility.
use_when: You need a feature‑rich grid for large datasets
You require built‑in editing, sorting, filtering, grouping or export functionality
You want a single widget that handles paging, infinite scrolling and column resizing
avoid_when: You only need a simple list or table
You are building a lightweight app with minimal dependencies
You are constrained by a commercial license
strengths: Rich feature set (editing, grouping, export, RTL)
weaknesses: Commercial license required (free only for community)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, obtain Syncfusion license key and add it in code (SfLicense.registerLicense). No build_runner needed.
